patch_description: This replaces the deep ring-based rotation circuit with a compact QAOA-style ansatz. Commuting ZZ interactions connect qubits through the three perfect matchings of a 3-dimensional hypercube, allowing information to propagate globally with low depth. All interactions share one parameter, while all RY mixers share a second parameter. This strong parameter tying acts as regularization for the small training set, reduces the train-validation gap, and should converge faster while retaining substantially richer nonlocal correlations than the previous CZ ring.
